summary.text: Russell Andrews, who also goes by Russ, is the Republican candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 57, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Elizabeth Velasco.
His campaign website says he is running to protect rural Colorado, its water and its way of life.

paragraphs.text: Andrews advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary.

His campaign website says he will work to protect water, farmers and ranchers, transportation corridors and constitutional rights, and it lists defending the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights (TABOR) and opposing tax increases among his platform items.
